tcs.tc_title: Engine running -> heat, vent and steering wheel switches activatable
tcs.test_item:
IF ($EngRun_Stat$ = [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN])then The HMI shall allow activation of the heated and vented seats and the heated steering wheel switches.

(Engine running)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足等於條件之匯流排值
2. Select the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches on the Climate screen and check that each switch activates
tcs.expected_result:
1. PENDING: DR-19
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches each change to the activated state

tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive configuration applied to the HMI
tcs.test_item:
If $DriverSide$ = [Right hand drive] the HMI shall be modified as defined by HMI requirements.

(Right-hand drive configuration accepted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
2. The Climate screen is reachable from the Menu Bar
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU so that PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) is applied
2. PENDING: DR-20 條文以「as defined by HMI requirements」交叉參照，未指名該 HMI 需求，無可判定之修改項
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up and the Climate screen is displayed
2. PENDING: DR-20
